suggested_routes.label: Vendor partnership — LedgerBridge invoicing compliance
suggested_routes.rationale: The meeting opener states that the SpendNest representative is assessing whether LedgerBridge can provide compliant invoicing coverage. This is an internal vendor evaluation or partnership discussion, not a customer-facing sales meeting.

concise_output: A SpendNest strategy and partnerships team member opened this meeting with LedgerBridge to assess whether LedgerBridge can deliver compliant invoicing coverage. This is a vendor/partner evaluation requiring an internal action.
what_established: The SpendNest attendee works on strategy and partnerships. The purpose of the meeting is to evaluate LedgerBridge as a potential supplier of compliant invoicing coverage.
what_not_established: Whether LedgerBridge can meet the requirement, commercial terms, compliance scope, meeting outcome, or who attended from LedgerBridge.
next_action: Capture LedgerBridge's compliance certifications and invoicing coverage scope; schedule a follow-up with legal or finance to assess fit before any partnership commitment.
uncertainty: Only the opening turn is available; LedgerBridge's response and meeting outcome are not evidenced.
